audience: Sales and marketing teams that enrich contact lists with professional emails in Dropcontact

useCases.title: Check remaining credits
useCases.text: Read the credits left on the Dropcontact account. This check does not use credits.

useCases.title: Enrich a list of contacts
useCases.text: Submit 1 to 250 contacts for B2B enrichment, then fetch the records for the request ID. A credit is used only when an email is found.

useCases.title: Collect results for a running batch
useCases.text: Fetch the records for a request ID. If the batch is still running, the result says so. Set force_results to get the records already enriched.

useCases.title: Check the default webhook
useCases.text: Read the default webhook URL that Dropcontact calls when an enrichment result is ready. The result is null when none is set.
